name: Monolith
line: A single block of calm, floating on a walnut plinth.
text: Monolith is our signature piece: a deep, hand-finished stone-look slab resting on a recessed plinth of solid walnut. The shadow gap between the two makes the top appear to hover a few centimetres above the floor.

name: Dune
text: Dune is built up layer by layer and carved by hand until every ridge flows into the next, like sandstone shaped by centuries of wind. The top is honed smooth; the sides keep their raw, open grain.

name: Tectonic
line: Two rock forms carrying a sheet of clear glass.
text: Tectonic pairs two sculpted rock forms with a floating oval of tempered glass. Each base is shaped by hand, so no two tables share the same fault lines.

name: Mesa
line: A broken slab with a perfectly honed top.
text: Mesa contrasts a calm, honed surface with a deeply fractured edge, as if lifted straight from a quarry wall. Low, heavy in presence, light in reality.

name: Magma
line: Cooled lava, bronze glints, clear glass.
text: Magma is a single dark volcanic form with a natural arch at its heart, finished with a subtle bronze patina that catches warm light. Topped with tempered glass.

name: Grotto
line: A mirror set into the mouth of a cave.
text: Grotto frames the glass with a deep, porous rock surround, sculpted and textured entirely by hand. It turns a hallway into an entrance.

name: Erosion
line: Tall, soft, shaped like water shapes stone.
text: Erosion leans against the wall like a monolith worn smooth by a river. The organic opening follows the flow of the frame rather than a straight line.

name: Drift
line: Twisted ropes of stone around a tall glass.
text: Drift wraps the mirror in braided, rope-like forms, each strand modelled by hand. Sculptural from every angle, made to lean or to hang.

name: Basalt
line: Split volcanic plates with a bronze edge.
text: Basalt surrounds the glass with dark, cleaved plates of stone-look rock, each edge touched with bronze. Dramatic in warm, low light.

name: Luna
line: Craters and calm — a moon for the wall.
text: Luna is a round, porous frame with softly hollowed craters around a fluid mirror. Compact enough for a powder room, strong enough for a living room.

name: Pebble
dims: Ø 45 cm each · made to measure drop
line: Three faceted stones, glowing from within.
text: Pebble hangs as a cluster of three hand-faceted shades. The interior is left raw so the light breaks warm and soft across every edge.

name: Pebble
dims: Ø 45 cm each · made to measure drop
line: The same stones, washed in daylight.
text: The chalk version of Pebble: a soft, porous white surface that turns any room calm and bright, day or night.

name: Strata
text: Strata is sculpted by hand directly on your wall, layered like a canyon face and lit from above to reveal every ridge.

name: Fault Line
line: Dark rock split by a vein of light.
text: Fault Line is a dark, fractured wall sculpted by hand on site, with light running through its cracks — a centrepiece for lobbies, hallways and lounges.

name: Grotto Arch
text: A passage sculpted by hand around your existing doorway, turning it into the entrance of a cave, with concealed lighting along its base.
